response.original_title: [FAQs-Guide] How to Add Another Passenger to Your Icon of the Seas Reservation
response.overview: To add another passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Icon of the Seas reservation +1-866-254-7549, you must call Royal Caribbean customer service directly +1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be processed online +1-866-254-7549 or via the mobile app. Requirements and Rules Stateroom Capacity: Your current room must not exceed its maximum permitted guest occupancy +1-866-254-7549.Lifeboat Limits: The total ship capacity and lifeboat limits for the sailing must allow for another person +1-866-254-7549.Timing: Additions need to be completed before the final ship manifest is submitted +1-866-254-7549, which is typically around 72 hours before departure. Pricing: The new passenger will be charged at the current prevailing cruise fare +1-866-254-7549, along with applicable taxes, port fees, and deposits.
